mapper.select: select r.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone from hys_recharge r left join hys_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.recharge_id = #{rechargeId}
select r.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone from hys_recharge r left join hys_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} order by r.recharge_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into hys_recharge (member_id, amount_cents, status, audit_by, audit_time, remark, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{amountCents}, #{status}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_recharge set status = #{status}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, remark = #{remark} where recharge_id = #{rechargeId} and status = 'AUDITING'
